'''Node Lamps''' are utility blocks that react to the presence of a [[Dispatcher (Disambiguation)|Dispatcher]].
{{Item Info
|image1=Node Lamp.png
|id=srparasites:node_redstone_lamp
}}

==''Obtainment''==
Node Lamps can only be obtained by crafting one with four [[Dispatcher Membrane|Dispatcher Membranes]] and a Redstone Lamp.
{{CraftingTable|r1_b1=Dispatcher Membrane|r1_a2=Dispatcher Membrane|r1_c2=Dispatcher Membrane|r1_b2=Redstone Lamp|r1_b3=Dispatcher Membrane|r1_output=Node Lamp|r1_count=1}}

==''Usage''==
Node Lamps can detect the presence of Dispatchers in a 250-block radius and light up, emitting a redstone signal. When right-clicking, it presents Signal Strength and Signal Distance. Signal Strength is related to the level of the nearest Dispatcher, meaning the value can either be [[Stage I Dispatcher|I]], [[Stage II Dispatcher|II]], [[Stage III Dispatcher|III]], or [[Stage IV Dispatcher|IV]]. Signal Distance relates to how close the nearest Dispatcher is, the closest being 1 and the farthest being 5. When a Node Lamp cannot detect a Dispatcher, the Signal Distance will always be 0.
